id: title:arnohillen:label eval events with the run s own namespace

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a taxonomy entry for AI evaluation metadata, potentially distinguishing this evaluation source in dashboards.
review.reason: Adds a single entry to an allowed values list for an AI evaluation source taxonomy. This is a narrow, localized maintenance change. The implementation of the actual evaluation harness or scoring logic is not present, so the tier cannot be raised. No score multiplier or adoption inference is applied.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based solely on the presence of a taxonomy entry, not the implementation of the evaluation capability. The actual benefit and operational impact depend on unverified downstream implementation and adoption, which are not demonstrated in this chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new 'one-shot' evaluation run or the scoring harnesses, only the taxonomy and event-emitting wrappers. This makes it impossible to establish the tier of the change.
